onset.Description: Onset of the event relative to the first retained volume (_0006.nii, after discarding 5 dummy volumes)

trial_type.Description: Experimental condition or event category (block-level conditions match SPM12 GLM regressors: delay_0ms, delay_100ms, delay_300ms, delay_1000ms, incongruent, authorship_report; trial-level entries are prefixed with trial_)

Levels.delay_0ms: 16 s task block with 0 ms gaze-contingent window delay (SPM12 regressor: 0_ms)
Levels.delay_100ms: 16 s task block with 100 ms gaze-contingent window delay (SPM12 regressor: 100_ms)
Levels.delay_300ms: 16 s task block with 300 ms gaze-contingent window delay (SPM12 regressor: 300_ms)
Levels.delay_1000ms: 16 s task block with 1000 ms gaze-contingent window delay (SPM12 regressor: 1000_ms)
Levels.incongruent: 16 s task block with spatially mirrored (X or Y axis) and temporally delayed (300 or 1000 ms) window (SPM12 regressor: Incongruency)
Levels.authorship_report: Post-block subjective agency report period (1 s fixation + 3 s response window, modeled as 2 scans = 4 s regressor Q in SPM12)
Levels.trial_delay_0ms: Single 2 s visual comparison trial within a 0 ms delay block
Levels.trial_delay_100ms: Single 2 s visual comparison trial within a 100 ms delay block
Levels.trial_delay_300ms: Single 2 s visual comparison trial within a 300 ms delay block
Levels.trial_delay_1000ms: Single 2 s visual comparison trial within a 1000 ms delay block
Levels.trial_incongruent: Single 2 s visual comparison trial within an incongruent block

event_level.Description: Granularity level of the event row (filter by 'block' and 'report' for block-design GLM, or 'trial' for single-trial analyses)

Levels.report: 4 s subjective authorship report window following a task block
Levels.trial: Individual 2 s Go/No-Go visual comparison trial within a block

block_number.Description: Block index within the run (1 to 20)

trial_in_block.Description: Trial index within the block (1 to 5 for trial rows; n/a for block/report rows)

total_trial_number.Description: Cumulative trial index within the run (1 to 100 for trial rows; n/a for block/report rows)

temporal_delay_ms.Description: Temporal delay between saccade onset and gaze-contingent window update

controllable.Description: Whether the gaze-contingent window position was controlled by the participant's gaze (1) or spatially mirrored (-1)

Levels.X: Mirrored across the central X axis
Levels.Y: Mirrored across the central Y axis

target_existence.Description: Whether the central Chinese character matched the peripheral characters (Go/No-Go target status)

Levels.1: Go trial (target present: central and peripheral characters identical)
Levels.0: No-Go trial (target absent: central and peripheral characters different)

stimulus_index.Description: Index of the presented Chinese character array bitmap (0 to 99)

go_response.Description: Whether the participant pressed the Go response button during the trial or immediately following ISI

response_time.Description: Go response time from trial start (including initial central fixation mask period), or in_isi if pressed during ISI

saccade_arrive_time_ms.Description: Time when gaze arrived at one of the four peripheral character ROIs

saccade_target_location.Description: Peripheral character ROI fixated by the participant

agency_judgment.Description: EDF-verified subjective agency judgment reported at the end of the block

Levels.self: Display update was self-initiated with no perceived delay (button 2, green)
Levels.delay: Display update was self-initiated but delayed (button 3, yellow)
Levels.other: Display update appeared manipulated by the computer (button 4, red)

agency_judgment_code.Description: Numeric code for EDF-verified subjective agency judgment (2=self, 3=delay, 4=other)

agency_judgment_raw_code.Description: Raw numeric button code logged in CSV prior to EDF verification of accidental thumb button (1) presses
